head: Uber Eats drone delivery starts near Houston with Zipline
dek: Uber Eats drone delivery with Zipline started on 17 November in Spring, Texas, a suburb of Houston: you tap a new Drone icon in the app and the order is lowered into your yard on a tether. Dallas is next, and dozens more US cities are planned.
details: Drones carry orders of up to 8 pounds in a sealed pod, fly about 300 feet up at up to 70 mph and don't land. In Spring the service runs from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. for eligible customers within 10 miles of a participating restaurant, such as Jersey Mike's, Zaxby's, Urban Bird and Abu Omar Halal. No tip is needed for a drone order, and you can still pick a regular driver. Delivery fees weren't given; Uber and Zipline aim for one million drone deliveries a day by the end of 2029.
where: Uber Eats app, Spring, Texas now; Dallas next
means: If you live in the Spring area, some restaurant orders can now arrive by drone instead of a driver, as long as you have an open spot outside to drop it.
todo: Open Uber Eats and look for the Drone icon on the home page; pick a restaurant, order, and confirm an open drop-off spot such as a lawn.
thumb_words: UBER EATS DRONES START IN TEXAS
